messages:
alex: quick question on PR #712 — i pushed the function rename per review but CI is failing lint. anyone have a sec to confirm if we should keep snake_case or switch to camelCase for the helper in `src/utils/seq_utils.py`? also need an approval after nits.

chris: we prefer snake_case for python modules. the linter rule is `N802` in pyproject+ruff. if you change the fn to `prefix_cache` that's fine. i can approve after the fix.

maya: tiny nit: rename `prefCache` -> `prefix_cache`. you can run `ruff format` + `ruff check --fix` locally; it'll handle imports. also update the docstring line that mentions the old name.

alex: thanks — pushing fix now. snippet:```diff
- def prefCache(seq, prefix):
+ def prefix_cache(seq, prefix):
```

linter-bot: check/ruff failed — 3 errors: N802 (invalid function name), D401 (docstring should start with verb), E501 (line too long). rerun after fixes.

alex: pushed at 1725004922 — ran `ruff check --fix` and updated docstring. hopin' for a quick review.

chris: looking... small question: are tests still referencing the old name? run `rg prefCache` to be safe.

alex: updated tests, ran unit tests locally (all passing). requested CI rerun.

ci-bot: build triggered — unit-tests started. integration suite will run after.

ci-bot: unit-tests passed ✅ (58m). integration failing on a flaky rerank test unrelated to this PR, requeueing. tagging @sam for merge timing.

sam: FYI release cutoff in ~3 hours. if merge goes green and chris approves, please merge now; else hold for next patch. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

chris: approved :thumbsup: — will merge after green.

alex: thanks all. cc @maya for docstring check — lmk if you want a follow-up PR for any cleanup.

maya: looks good to me. one small style nit left but not blocking. :ok_hand:
